title: International Scholarship Programme of the Avicenna Studienwerk
summary: Supports international Muslim students and doctoral candidates enrolled at German higher education institutions with financial and non-material assistance.

degree_levels.notes: Enrolment for a Master's degree or doctorate at a German higher education institution.

subject_areas.notes: all fields of study and subjects

nationality.notes: Target group includes international students and doctoral candidates; specific country eligibility requires selecting from the database country list.

residence.notes: Enrolment or at least acceptance at a German higher education institution.

mandatory.text: above average potential for academic/research achievement
enrolment (or at least acceptance) for a Master's degree or doctorate at a German higher education institution
German language proficiency (B2 level or above)

exceptions.text: Exceptions are possible for the German language proficiency requirement.

funding.description: Monthly scholarship for students 844 EUR / for doctoral candidates 1,275 EUR. Additional monthly healthcare allowance: 100 EUR, monthly travel allowance: 100 EUR. Possible additional benefits: family allowance, start-up/book allowance and printing cost subsidy.
funding.duration: Entire duration of the Master's programme (standard period of study). Doctoral studies are funded for a maximum period of 3 years (36 months).

application_rounds.notes: The scholarships are awarded annually. Current deadlines can be found on the programme website.

required_documents.text: certificate of higher education entrance qualification (Abitur, A-Levels, etc.)
university certificate and if applicable job references
short outline of your dissertation project (max. 3 pages) (for doctoral candidates only)

sources.title: International Scholarship Programme of the Avicenna Studienwerk - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Funds international students and doctoral candidates for studying or researching in Germany.
